prompt: This anime illustration depicts a bustling morning at a fishing harbor with vibrant colors and dynamic lines. In the center foreground, a fisherman in a yellow raincoat lifts a heavy crate of silver mackerel, his muscles tensed. To his left, a girl with blue hair and a white sailor uniform points excitedly at a large tuna being weighed on a scale by a burly dockworker in orange overalls. On the right, a stray black cat with bright green eyes sits atop a stack of blue fishing nets, observing the scene. Behind them, a small boy in a red cap holds a fishing rod, looking up at a seagull perched on a wooden post. Another seagull flies mid-air in the upper left, wings spread wide against the sky. The dockworker hands a receipt to the fisherman, while the girl leans forward eagerly. Wooden pilings and ropes create depth in the mid-ground, leading to calm blue water where three small fishing boats bob gently. The background features distant hills and a lighthouse under a bright sun with stylized rays. Soft cel-shading defines the characters, and sparkles highlight the wet fish scales and water droplets, emphasizing the fresh, energetic atmosphere of the coastal town.
